items.title: Applied Materials Stocks Climb 5.72% a Day Before Fourth-Quarter Results
items.summary: Applied guided to $10.25 billion of quarterly revenue; results and a 4:30 p.m. ET call arrive Thursday.

items.title: Applied Materials fiscal Q4 2026 earnings preview: what to watch for in the print
items.summary: Investing.com -- Applied Materials (AMAT) reports fiscal Q4 2026 on Thursday, Nov 12, after the close. The stock trades at $403.89 (+8.42%) as of Nov 11, 12:34 PM EST, with a market cap of about $320B. That is a bounce, but it sits well below the 52-week high of $739.67. The 1M return is -20.34%.

items.title: 3 Tech Dividend Stocks That Could Turn $300,000 Into $4,200 in Annual Income
items.summary: Tech stocks rarely get picked to replace a paycheck, yet three of them pay dividends backed by billions in free cash flow. One of the trio has not raised its payout since 2019, and the reason may surprise income seekers.

items.title: Valens Semiconductor, Ltd. (VLN) Reports Q3 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
items.summary: PTK Acquisition (VLN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +33.33% and +1.92%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Applied Materials Is Up 59% in a Year, Even After Halving From Its High: “Double Our Output”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApplied Materials stock is up 59% over the past year, even after losing about half its value since its June 30 record close. Record quarters drove the climb, and worries about AI spending, sparked partly by Lam Research’s outlook, drove the fall, with no bad news from Applied itself.

items.title: Capital Group Dividend Value (CGDV) Adds Oracle and Corning on Monday
items.summary: The $38.77 billion fund bought $140.4 million of Oracle and $108.0 million of Corning while selling $69.6 million of Alphabet.

items.title: ETFs Bought $317.1 Million of Applied Materials (AMAT) on Monday
items.summary: ETFs bought $317.1 million of Applied Materials on Monday, with 51 funds buying and 22 selling.

items.title: Chip Stocks Jump as CoreWeave Eases AI Fears
items.summary: Semiconductor shares surged in premarket trading Wednesday, leading broad market gains as blowout earnings from specialized cloud provider CoreWeave quelled fears of an impending slowdown in artificial intelligence hardware demand.
